sloka: स त्वदागमनं श्रुत्वा सहैभिर्हरियूथपैः ।प्रहृष्टो न तु रुष्टो ऽसौ वनं श्रुत्वा प्रधर्षितम् ।। ५.६४.९ ।।।।
transliteration: sa tvadāgamanaṁ śrutvā sahaibhirhariyūthapaiḥ ।prahṛṣṭo na tu ruṣṭo 'sau vanaṁ śrutvā pradharṣitam ।। 5.64.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "He was not angry at your destruction of the garden. On the other hand, he was very glad to hear about your arrival.
